scenario.title: 寄錯檔案、忘記回信，怎麼道歉
scenario.context: 出包後的英文要做到三件事：承認、說明發生什麼事、提出補救。說明經過時常會用到「我正在做 A 的時候，B 發生了」，這就是過去進行式 + when / while 的主場。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: Minz, the client just emailed. They said the file you sent was the old version?
lines.zh: Minz，客戶剛寄信來，說你寄的檔案是舊版？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Oh no. That's on me. I'm so sorry.
lines.zh: 糟了，是我的錯，真的很抱歉。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I was exporting the final files when the software crashed. I must have attached the backup by mistake.
lines.zh: 我在匯出最終檔的時候軟體當掉了，我一定是不小心附到備份檔。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: OK, these things happen. Did they print anything yet?
lines.zh: 好，這種事難免。他們已經印了嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I don't think so. I'll send the correct file right now and call them to double-check.
lines.zh: 應該還沒。我現在寄正確的檔案，再打電話跟他們確認。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: Good. And let's add a file-check step before anything goes out.
lines.zh: 好。以後東西寄出前我們加一道檢查檔案的步驟。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Hey, did you ever reply to the printer? They called me asking about the paper.
lines.zh: 嘿，你有回印刷廠嗎？他們打給我問紙的事。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Ugh, my bad! I was reading their email while I was on a call, and I totally forgot about it.
lines.zh: 唉，我的錯！我在講電話時看了他們的信，然後就完全忘了。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: No worries. I told them you'd get back to them today.
lines.zh: 沒關係，我跟他們說你今天會回覆。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Thanks for covering. I really dropped the ball on that one.
lines.zh: 謝謝你幫我擋，那件事我真的漏掉了。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Hey, everyone messes up sometimes. Last month I screwed up a whole invoice.
lines.zh: 嘿，每個人都會出包。上個月我整張發票都搞砸了。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Ha, I remember. OK, replying now.

patterns.note: 承擔責任最簡潔有力的說法

chinglish.right: Sorry, I made a mistake. / Sorry, my mistake.
chinglish.why: 錯誤已經發生，要用過去式 made。

chinglish.wrong: When I send the email, the computer was crashed.
chinglish.right: I was sending the email when my computer crashed.
chinglish.why: 兩個錯：「正在寄」要用過去進行式；crash 是主動發生，不用被動。

chinglish.wrong: Sorry sorry sorry, is my fault.
chinglish.right: I'm really sorry. That's my fault.
chinglish.why: 中文可以連說好幾次「抱歉」，英文一次 really sorry 就夠了，而且 is my fault 少了主詞。

chinglish.wrong: I will pay attention next time.
chinglish.right: I'll double-check everything from now on.
chinglish.why: 「下次會注意」直翻有點空泛，英文職場更期待聽到具體的改善方法。

grammar.title: 過去進行式＋when / while
grammar.oneLiner: 過去進行式（was / were + V-ing）是「背景」，過去式是「打斷它的事件」；while 接背景，when 常接事件。
whenToUse: 過去某個時間點正在做的事：At 3 p.m. I was talking to a client.
背景 + 打斷事件：I was exporting the files when the software crashed.
while + 進行式（兩件事同時在持續）：I was reading the email while I was on a call.
when + 過去式（突然發生的事件）：The power went out when I was saving the file.
兩個句子可以對調順序，放前面的子句後加逗號：When the software crashed, I was exporting the files.
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文用「正在…的時候」表達背景，動詞本身不變，所以台灣人說故事時常整段用過去式（或整段用現在式）。英文聽眾需要知道哪個動作是背景、哪個是突發事件，才能理解經過。出包時把背景和事件講清楚，聽起來更像在說明狀況，而不是在找藉口。

examples.correct: I was presenting when my laptop died.
examples.incorrect: I presented when my laptop was dying.
examples.note: 背景用進行式，突發事件用過去式。

examples.correct: While I was waiting for the bus, I answered some emails.
What were you doing when the client called?
She was typing while he was talking.
When I got to the office, everyone was waiting for me.
examples.note: 我到的時候，大家已經在等（背景）。

quiz.question: I ___ the files when the power went out.
quiz.explanation: 被打斷的背景動作用過去進行式。

quiz.question: The client ___ while I was in the shower.
What ___ you doing at 10 last night?
quiz.explanation: you 的過去進行式用 were。

quiz.question: ___ I was driving to work, I remembered the deadline. (當…的時候，接持續動作)
quiz.explanation: while 接持續的背景動作（when 也可以）。

quiz.question: I was ___ an email when I noticed the typo.

slang.usage: 小錯誤時的隨口道歉，例如撞到人、拿錯東西。

risk.note: 只適合小事和熟人。對客戶或大錯誤說 my bad 會顯得不當一回事，要用 I'm sorry, that's my fault。

examples.en: Oh, my bad. I thought this was my coffee.
examples.zh: 喔，我的錯，我以為這杯是我的咖啡。

examples.en: My bad, I forgot to add you to the invite.
examples.zh: 抱歉，我忘了把你加進邀請。

slang.usage: 該負責的事沒做好，像球賽中漏接。I dropped the ball on that.

risk.note: 職場承認疏失的常用說法，說自己沒問題；說別人要注意語氣。

examples.en: I dropped the ball on the follow-up email. Sorry about that.
examples.zh: 後續追蹤的信我漏掉了，抱歉。

examples.en: Someone dropped the ball, and the order never went out.
examples.zh: 有人疏忽了，訂單一直沒寄出。

slang.usage: mess up / mess something up。名詞 a mess-up = 出包。

risk.note: 口語但不粗俗，職場可用。

examples.en: I messed up the order, so I'll fix it.
examples.zh: 我把訂單搞砸了，我來處理。

examples.en: Don't worry, everyone messes up sometimes.
examples.zh: 別擔心，每個人都會出錯。

slang.meaning: 搞砸（比 mess up 重）
slang.usage: screw up / screw something up；名詞 a screw-up。

risk.note: 有點粗，雖然美國職場私下常聽到，但對客戶、主管或正式場合用 mess up / make a mistake。

examples.en: I really screwed up the presentation.
Whoever screwed up the schedule, please fix it.
examples.zh: 不管是誰把班表搞亂的，請修好。

review.question: Could you tell me where ___?
review.explanation: 複習第 27 單元：間接問句用肯定語序。

review.question: Let me run it ___ my manager before I say yes.
review.explanation: 複習第 27 單元：run it by = 先確認。

review.question: I ___ this bug all afternoon and I still can't find it.
review.explanation: 複習第 26 單元：持續到現在的動作。

review.question: I'll ___ the intern fix the typo.
review.explanation: 複習第 24 單元：安排屬下做事用 have + 原形。

review.question: What did the client ___ about the new logo?
review.explanation: 複習第 20 單元：後面沒接人用 say。

review.question: Don't worry, I've ___ sent the correct version. (剛剛)
review.explanation: 複習第 12 單元：just = 剛剛。

review.question: You sent a client the wrong invoice. The best apology is:
options: I'm so sorry, that's on me. I'll send the correct one now.
review.explanation: 對客戶要正式承認並提出補救。
